tasks.check: deno check shared/ web/src/gain.ts web/src/errorReporting.ts $(ls server/*.ts | grep -v main.ts)
tasks.//test: `--allow-read=.` is for the two guards in web/src/idb_test.ts, which read the sources they are asserting about. It is the process floor; those tests narrow it again with their own `permissions` block, and every other test still runs with nothing.
tasks.//fmt: Always this, never `deno fmt <path under web/>`: given a path inside web/, Deno finds web/package.json first, ignores this file, and reformats at the default width instead of lineWidth 100 -- so the gate then rejects what fmt just wrote.
tasks.gate: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno task check && deno task test && deno task web:build && deno task test:bundle
tasks.//test:bundle: Runs *after* web:build in the gate, never as part of `test`. It reads web/dist, so running it first checks whichever bundle happened to be lying around -- and on a fresh clone there is none, and it would skip in silence.
tasks.journey: cd web && npm run build && cd .. && node tools/journey.mjs
tasks.shots: cd web && npm run build && cd .. && node tools/screenshots.mjs
tasks.desktop: deno task web:build && deno desktop --backend webview --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --exclude node_modules --exclude web/node_modules --include web/dist desktop/main.ts
tasks.desktop:build: deno task web:build && deno desktop --backend webview --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --exclude node_modules --exclude web/node_modules --include web/dist -o Worklog desktop/main.ts
